notice: Hypothetical engineering and evaluation fixture. No person, claimed invention, source reference, measurement, filing or patentability conclusion in this fixture is real. Never import it into production evidence.

input.idea: Control a shared spending allowance across AI workers that can clone, delegate tasks and retry operations.

artifacts.text: Workers can duplicate process state. A copied in-memory balance does not reliably represent remaining authority.
What happens when a payment service accepts a request but the local worker times out?

input.goal: Explore a technically specific mechanism and assess whether any supported, commercially useful claim scope might remain after research.

assumptions: One defined consistency authority for each budget partition
Integer minor units and one currency
A real enforcement boundary prevents workers bypassing allocation policy
External provider outcome can eventually be investigated

transitions.effect: Transfer authority; do not duplicate it.
Consume once for the authoritative operation record.
Release only when the configured evidence policy establishes it is safe.

limitations: No claim of unrestricted partition availability
No guarantee that every payment provider can be reconciled automatically
No claim of novelty for transactions, fencing or idempotency alone

faultScenarios.trigger: Two clones redeem the same operation ID
faultScenarios.expected: One authoritative result under the specified provider contract; no duplicate local consumption.

faultScenarios.trigger: Two clones redeem distinct operation IDs against the same allowance
faultScenarios.expected: Atomic aggregate bound; idempotency alone is insufficient.

faultScenarios.trigger: Parent spends authority already transferred to a child
faultScenarios.expected: Transferred portion unavailable to parent; no nested double counting.

faultScenarios.trigger: Coordinator commits then crashes before response
faultScenarios.expected: Retry resolves the existing operation or recorded uncertainty.

faultScenarios.trigger: Payment provider accepts then network times out
faultScenarios.expected: Retain reservation, record unknown outcome, reconcile without blind resubmission.

faultScenarios.trigger: Old worker resumes after recovery epoch increment
faultScenarios.expected: Reject stale epoch before a new authorized side effect.
Defer or reject unless a separately bounded offline partition is explicitly specified.
Apply the declared refund policy once; do not silently mint spending authority.
Identify a safety defect unless the consistency model prevents conflicting authority.
